metadata.pulp_backend_reporting: The worker does not print the selected Pulp backend; parent and candidate use the same host dispatch and x86-64-v3 RUSTFLAGS.
metadata.measurement_note: Each process timed ten warm batches after setup/repeat/reset checks; durable evidence retains per-process median latency and summarized wait/frequency diagnostics, not raw host/process snapshots.
metadata.runner_artifact_note: Archived runner uses RUSTSHT_REPO or derives the repository root from its evidence-directory location; its measurement logic matches the executed runner.
